title: Blackbull
summary: Blackbull is a large bull-like Litho-Titan that is used by both Diaz and Snake.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: Snake invoked Blackbull in Pamplona to attack the Huntik team in order to recover the [[Amulets|Amulet]] of [[Ghostfog]]. Because it was the running of the bulls in Spain, Blackbull did not stand out among the many bulls at the festival. Diaz also invoked a Blackbull but it was defeated by [[Dante Vale]]. {{Source|The Bulls of Pamplona}}

sections.wikitext:
Able to cover great distances, Blackbull is a Titan of tremendous speed, strength, and stamina. With his large, powerful, razor-sharp horns, he can demolish what stands before him, be it a Seeker or a Titan.

full_text:
Blackbull is a large bull-like Litho-Titan that is used by both Diaz and Snake.

History

Snake invoked Blackbull in Pamplona to attack the Huntik team in order to recover the Amulet of Ghostfog. Because it was the running of the bulls in Spain, Blackbull did not stand out among the many bulls at the festival. Diaz also invoked a Blackbull but it was defeated by Dante Vale. [The Bulls of Pamplona]

Abilities

Able to cover great distances, Blackbull is a Titan of tremendous speed, strength, and stamina. With his large, powerful, razor-sharp horns, he can demolish what stands before him, be it a Seeker or a Titan.
